name: Old Town
_doc: A 1v1 temperate map (P3-23c), its feature a city center: 32 garrisonable town houses (P3-05) in a grid of narrow streets around a central square, with a data center on the square that sees far over the town. The wide east-west road through the square is the fast way in; the streets favor infantry. Farmland and hedgerows outside. Mirrored across x = 128 (terrain_gen.mirror_x makes the heights exact).
_terrain_doc: height.r16 is built from terrain_gen by tools/make_heightmap.py: gentle hills and hedgerows raised above the fields. No water.
_obstacles_doc: Hedgerows and copses [x_m, y_m, w_m, h_m], west side first, then their mirrors.
_civilian_doc: Town houses [x_m, y_m, w_m, h_m, roof_height_m] (P3-05): two columns a side of eight, with 8 m streets between the rows and the 32 m road through the middle; west side first, then their mirrors.
_neutral_doc: Capturable neutral buildings [building_id, x_m, y_m] (P3-08a), west side first, then mirrors, then the data center on the middle line (its even footprint mirrors onto itself).
_supply_doc: Per side: a safe site by the base, north-west and south-west expansions, and a contested one on the square.
